items_all.title: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
items_all.summary: 製造業推動後量子密碼學（Post-Quantum Cryptography，PQC）轉型，面臨的問題不只是更換加密演演算法。網路安全業者Forescout從營運技術（OT）環境分析PQC轉型，指出OT環境的密碼學機制不只用於保護網路連線，也分佈在韌體數位簽章、安全開機及裝置身分等功能。企業因此需要找出既有裝置及系統使用哪些密碼學機制，並確認這些機制能否升級；無法升級的裝置，未來可能需要採取額外防護措施甚至汰換。

items_all.title: Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size
items_all.summary: Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open model with 740 million parameters that converts text, images, video, audio, and code into vectors. It runs on-device, needs only about 191 MB of RAM, and outperforms some competing models twice its size, according to Google. Paired with a small open model like Gemma 4, it can run offline RAG apps without sending data to external servers. The article Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據 Google 指出，Google 推出了 EmbeddingGemma 2，這是一個擁有 7.4 億個參數的開放模型，能將文字、圖片、影片、音訊和程式碼轉換為向量。它可在裝置上執行，僅需約 191 MB 的記憶體，且效能超越某些體積大上一倍的競爭模型。搭配像 Gemma 4 這樣的小型開放模型，它可以在不需要將資料傳送至外部伺服器的情況下執行離線 RAG 應用程式。文章〈Google 宣稱 EmbeddingGemma 2 的效能超越體積大上一倍的競爭向量模型〉（The Decoder）率先報導。

items_all.title: Wikimedia confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents edited wikis, tried to compromise tools, and hammered its infrastructure
items_all.summary: According to the Wikimedia Foundation, rogue OpenAI agents edited wikis without permission, tried to abuse a citation tool as a proxy, and may have caused a partial Wikidata Query Service outage through massive crawling. Wikimedia says AI companies need to take responsibility for their agents instead of pushing the burden onto volunteer editors. The article Wikimedia confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents edited wikis, tried to compromise tools, and hammered its infrastructure appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據維基媒體基金會（Wikimedia Foundation）指出，失控的 OpenAI 代理未經許可編輯了維基百科、試圖濫用引用工具作為代理伺服器，並可能透過大規模爬蟲導致 Wikidata 查詢服務部分中斷。維基媒體表示，AI 公司必須為其代理負起責任，而不是將負擔推給志願編輯者。這篇題為「Wikimedia confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents edited wikis, tried to compromise tools, and hammered its infrastructure」的文章首先發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade
items_all.summary: Microsoft published a bearish AI outlook from Nobel economist Daron Acemoglu. He predicts about 1.5 percent GDP growth over ten years and at most five percent of jobs replaced. Bigger models won't move the needle, he argues. What's missing are practical apps that change how work gets done. The article Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 微軟 發表了諾貝爾經濟學獎得主達倫・艾塞默魯（Daron Acemoglu）對人工智慧抱持的悲觀看法。他預測，未來十年的 GDP 成長率大約為 1.5%，且最多隻有百分之五的工作被取代。他認為，更大的模型無法帶來實質改變。真正缺乏的是能夠改變工作方式的實用應用程式。這篇題為 微軟 的文章最先發表在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: Mistral Large 4 is Europe's trillion-parameter answer to US models that refuse security work
items_all.summary: Mistral's Large 4 is the company's biggest model yet, with one trillion parameters trained on its own European infrastructure. In the independent Intelligence Index, the model makes a big leap forward but still falls well short of Claude, GPT-6, and Chinese competitors. Mistral's main pitch is cybersecurity work that closed US models refuse to do. The article Mistral Large 4 is Europe's trillion-parameter answer to US models that refuse security work appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Mistral's Large 4 是該公司迄今為止最大的模型，擁有 1 兆個參數，是在其自己的歐洲基礎設施上訓練出來的。在獨立的「智慧指數」（Intelligence Index）中，該模型取得了巨大的進步，但仍然遠遠落後於 Claude、GPT-6 和中國競爭對手。Mistral's 的主要訴求是美國封閉模型拒絕承接的網路安全工作。本文 Mistral Large 4 is Europe's trillion-parameter answer to US models that refuse security work 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China
items_all.summary: Reflection has released Beam, its first open-weight model. The mixture-of-experts system activates just 23 billion of its 501 billion parameters per token and aims to match GLM 5.2 on coding and reasoning while using three to four times less compute. The strategy against Chinese open-weight rivals like Deepseek and Qwen is efficiency over raw performance. The article Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Reflection 發布了其首款開放權重模型 Beam。這套混合專家系統在每個 token 中僅啟動 501 億個參數中的 23 億個，旨在以少三到四倍的運算量，在編碼和推理能力上媲美 GLM 5.2。其針對 Deepseek 和 Qwen 等中國開放權重競爭對手的策略是效率優先於原始效能。本文「Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China」最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.summary: Researchers at PhAI Labs have expanded Yann LeCun's JEPA architecture to work across seven fields, from robotics to biomedicine. The effort also produced a liver cancer treatment candidate that showed promise in lab tests, though the study doesn't establish whether it could become an actual therapy. The article Researchers stretch LeCun's JEPA AI into a universal world model that works from physics to biology appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: PhAI Labs 的研究人員將 Yann LeCun 的 JEPA 架構擴展至七個領域，從機器人技術到生物醫學。這項工作還產生了一個肝癌治療候選藥物，在實驗室測試中顯示出潛力，儘管該研究並未確立它是否能成為真正的療法。這篇文章「Researchers stretch LeCun's JEPA AI into a universal world model that works from physics to biology」首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: ChatGPT圖片生成功能將出現視覺廣告
items_all.summary: OpenAI宣佈將擴大ChatGPT廣告測試，10月稍晚將在美國的圖片生成功能中測試新的視覺廣告，以圖片呈現商品或服務，並與使用者生成的圖片分開顯示。OpenAI也擴充廣告成效追蹤及投放安全機制，讓廣告主瞭解廣告是否帶來購買等後續行動，同時避免廣告出現在敏感或不適合的對話旁。 新的視覺廣告會在使用者生成圖片時出現，可使用商品照片、使用情境或服務相關圖片呈現，並會明確標示為廣告，不會混入使用者要求ChatGPT生成的圖片。首波測試僅限美國及部分廣告主，OpenAI表示，廣告也不會影響ChatGPT產生的回答。

It extends a run of breakthroughs that have both impressed and unsettled parts of the mathematical community while raising questions about research ethics and […]

items_all.title: Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model
items_all.summary: Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, as a public preview. It is a 1.05 trillion parameter Mixture of Experts model with 49 billion active parameters, native image input, and a 1 million token context window, trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own European datacenters. The API is live now; open weights ship end of October 2026. The post Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Mistral AI 已發布綽號為 Le Chonk 的 Mistral Large 4 進行公開預覽。這是一個擁有 1.05 兆引數的混合專家（MoE）模型，具備 490 億個活躍引數、原生影象輸入以及 100 萬個 Token 的上下文視窗，並在 Mistral's 位於歐洲的資料中心使用 3,800 個 輝達 Grace Blackwell GPU 進行訓練。API 現已上線；開源權重將於 2026 年 10 月底發布。這篇題為「Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model」的文章首先發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One
items_all.summary: Reka has released Rho-1, a 19B omni-reasoning model trained from scratch. One network reads and generates text, images, video and robot actions over a shared KV cache. A distilled variant returns a 5.3-second clip in about a second. It is a research preview with no public weights yet. The post Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Reka 推出了 Rho-1，這是一個從頭開始訓練的 190 億參數全能推理模型。單一網路透過共用的 KV 快取來讀取和生成文字、圖像、影片及機器人動作。其蒸餾版本能在約一秒內回傳 5.3 秒的剪輯。這是一個研究預覽版，目前尚未公開模型權重。這篇文章 Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields
items_all.summary: JEPA-Anything splits a JEPA's single latent target into 4 orthogonal factors, each with its own predictor. Tested across 7 domains, it beat matched JEPA baselines on all 10 dynamics tasks and cut Interventional Pong intervention error by 34.8%. The post Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: JEPA-Anything 將 JEPA 的單一潛在目標拆分為 4 個正交因素，每個因素都有自己的預測器。經過 7 個領域的測試，它在所有 10 個動態任務上都擊敗了匹配的 JEPA 基線，並將介入式乓球（Interventional Pong）的介入誤差降低了 34.8%。這篇題為「超越特定領域的世界模型：JEPA-Anything 以 1 種方法適用 7 個領域」的文章最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
items_all.summary: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects Given how tempting a target wikis are for rogue agent swarms, it's not a huge surprise that Wikipedia found evidence of that activity once they went looking: The Wikimedia Foundation conducted its own investigation to see whether Wikimedia websites had been similarly affected by AI agents, focusing on those operated by OpenAI. We can confirm that we have discovered some activity by these “rogue” OpenAI agents on Wikimedia platforms. The unauthorized bot activities included edits to our wikis, some unsuccessful attempts to exploit a public note-taking tool we host, and heavy traffic, which are described more below. They found evidence of agents editing sandbox pages, trying to use pieces of infrastructure such as Etherpad to help proxy content from elsewhere, and saw widespread crawling and "hundreds of thousands of data queries" to their Wikidata Query Service. My best guess is that most of this was a similar (or the same) swarm of agents as those that defaced that German wiki while training for research tasks. The Wikipedia sandbox wiki edits appear to have started on May 12th, and the initial test edits to the UseModWiki Sandbox page reported by that incident started on May 11th. Tags: wikimedia , wikipedia , wikis , ai , generative-ai , llms , ai-ethics , accidental-cyberattacks

items_all.title: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0
items_all.summary: Release: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0 OpenAI released their new Jev-style Decisions API , as previously announced at last week's DevDay. Since I already have an llm-typesafe plugin for talking to Jev, I had GPT-6 Astra read the new OpenAI API documentation and build an llm-openai-decisions plugin inspired by llm-typesafe . Unlike Jev, the new gpt-6-luna decision model supports image input in addition to text. Both models charge for input it and not for output: OpenAI's is 10 cents per million input tokens, Jev's is 4.2 cents per million. Otherwise the API shape is very similar to Jev, at least conceptually. Jev supports three question types for yes/no, choices, or scores. OpenAI Decisions supports the same three types. Install the plugin like this: llm install llm-openai-decisions Here's an example query against an image attachment: llm -m openai-decisions/gpt-6-luna \ -a https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2025/two-pelicans.jpg \ -s ' Does this image contain any mammals? ' And example output: { "type" : " predicate " , "name" : " evaluation " , "probability" : 0.0 } Consult the README for full details of how to run the other types of questions. Tags: openai , llm , coding-agents , jev

items_all.title: EmbeddingGemma 2
items_all.summary: My comment on EmbeddingGemma 2 — Hacker News. I really appreciate that EmbeddingGemma 2 is under the Apache 2.0 license. For embedding models in particular, I don't think it makes sense to use a closed, proprietary, hosted-only model. Most applications of embedding models involve calculating thousands or even millions of embedding vectors and storing them for later comparison. If your model is proprietary, the vendor is likely someday going to decide to stop offering that model. They'll have a better model to replace it, but you still need to pay to re-calculate those millions of stored existing vectors. (In April 2024 OpenAI offered to "cover the financial cost of users re-embedding content with these new models" - https://openai.com/index/gpt-4-api-general-availability/ - but I don't think that's something we can rely on from every provider.) Notably, I don't want to host the model myself . I'd much rather pay a provider for a hosted model while knowing that if they ever stop hosting it I can run the open weights version myself - or find another vendor who can do that for me. Tags: google , ai , generative-ai , embeddings , gemma

items_all.title: Introducing Mistral Large 4: Le chonk
items_all.summary: Introducing Mistral Large 4: Le chonk Mistral are back in the game. Today they're releasing a preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1 trillion parameter, 49 billion active parameter model trained on their own cluster of 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs. The preview is available via their API. They promise to release the open weights model at the "end of this month". The model only supports two reasoning levels - "none" and "high" - via the Mistral API. Here are both pelicans - the "high" one looks better, though surprisingly it only used 2,717 output tokens compared to "none" which used 3,275: On Artificial Analysis it scores 38 , just behind DeepSeek 4.1 Flash, which is a 552B model. It's a huge improvement on last December's Mistral Large 3, which drew this terrible pelican and scored 9 on AA . It's certainly not a Fable-class model, but it's great to see Mistral put out a model that's back to being maybe about 6 months behind the frontier. Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , mistral , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , llm-release

items_all.title: Scrimshaw Jukebox
items_all.summary: Tool: Scrimshaw Jukebox I wanted to see if Claude Opus 5.5 could compose music, so I tried this : I want you to write some computer game music for me. First design simple text based format for the music and build an artifact that can play it out loud - include some example tracks in that artifact I am looking for music of the quality of the original secret of Monkey Island It leaned a lot harder into the Monkey Island theme than I had intended, but the results are surprisingly good. I wonder if the ability to compose competent music is similar to the 3D graphics thing - a new capability for text models that emerged in the past few months? Would need some careful experiments with other recent and not-so-recent models to confirm if this is new or if they've been able to do this for a while. Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , claude , vibe-coding

items_all_raw.title: 製造業PQC轉型不只換演算法，OT設備升級與汰換成挑戰
items_all_raw.summary: 製造業推動後量子密碼學（Post-Quantum Cryptography，PQC）轉型，面臨的問題不只是更換加密演演算法。網路安全業者Forescout從營運技術（OT）環境分析PQC轉型，指出OT環境的密碼學機制不只用於保護網路連線，也分佈在韌體數位簽章、安全開機及裝置身分等功能。企業因此需要找出既有裝置及系統使用哪些密碼學機制，並確認這些機制能否升級；無法升級的裝置，未來可能需要採取額外防護措施甚至汰換。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI “rogue” agent activities found on Wikimedia projects Given how tempting a target wikis are for rogue agent swarms, it's not a huge surprise that Wikipedia found evidence of that activity once they went looking: The Wikimedia Foundation conducted its own investigation to see whether Wikimedia websites had been similarly affected by AI agents, focusing on those operated by OpenAI. We can confirm that we have discovered some activity by these “rogue” OpenAI agents on Wikimedia platforms. The unauthorized bot activities included edits to our wikis, some unsuccessful attempts to exploit a public note-taking tool we host, and heavy traffic, which are described more below. They found evidence of agents editing sandbox pages, trying to use pieces of infrastructure such as Etherpad to help proxy content from elsewhere, and saw widespread crawling and "hundreds of thousands of data queries" to their Wikidata Query Service. My best guess is that most of this was a similar (or the same) swarm of agents as those that defaced that German wiki while training for research tasks. The Wikipedia sandbox wiki edits appear to have started on May 12th, and the initial test edits to the UseModWiki Sandbox page reported by that incident started on May 11th. Tags: wikimedia , wikipedia , wikis , ai , generative-ai , llms , ai-ethics , accidental-cyberattacks

items_all_raw.title: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0
items_all_raw.summary: Release: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0 OpenAI released their new Jev-style Decisions API , as previously announced at last week's DevDay. Since I already have an llm-typesafe plugin for talking to Jev, I had GPT-6 Astra read the new OpenAI API documentation and build an llm-openai-decisions plugin inspired by llm-typesafe . Unlike Jev, the new gpt-6-luna decision model supports image input in addition to text. Both models charge for input it and not for output: OpenAI's is 10 cents per million input tokens, Jev's is 4.2 cents per million. Otherwise the API shape is very similar to Jev, at least conceptually. Jev supports three question types for yes/no, choices, or scores. OpenAI Decisions supports the same three types. Install the plugin like this: llm install llm-openai-decisions Here's an example query against an image attachment: llm -m openai-decisions/gpt-6-luna \ -a https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2025/two-pelicans.jpg \ -s ' Does this image contain any mammals? ' And example output: { "type" : " predicate " , "name" : " evaluation " , "probability" : 0.0 } Consult the README for full details of how to run the other types of questions. Tags: openai , llm , coding-agents , jev
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 發布：llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0 OpenAI 發布了他們全新的 Jev 風格 Decisions API，正如上週 DevDay 上所預告的那樣。由於我已經有一個用於與 Jev 對話的 llm-typesafe 外掛程式，我讓 GPT-6 Astra 讀取了新的 OpenAI API 檔案，並建構了一個受 llm-typesafe 啟發的 llm-openai-decisions 外掛程式。與 Jev 不同，新的 gpt-6-luna 決策模型除了支援文字外還支援影像輸入。兩個模型都對輸入收費，不對輸出收費：OpenAI's 為每百萬輸入代幣 10 美分，Jev 為每百萬 4.2 美分。除此之外，API 的形式與 Jev 非常相似，至少在概念上是如此。Jev 支援三種問題類型：是/否、選擇或分數。OpenAI Decisions 支援相同的三種類型。安裝此前掛程式指令如下：llm install llm-openai-decisions 以下是對影像附件進行查詢的範例：llm -m openai-decisions/gpt-6-luna \ -a https://static.simonwillison.net/static/2025/two-pelicans.jpg \ -s ' Does this image contain any mammals? ' 範例輸出：{ "type" : " predicate " , "name" : " evaluation " , "probability" : 0.0 } 請查閱 README 以瞭解執行其他類型問題的完整詳細資訊。標籤：openai, llm, coding-agents, jev

items_all_raw.title: EmbeddingGemma 2
items_all_raw.summary: My comment on EmbeddingGemma 2 — Hacker News. I really appreciate that EmbeddingGemma 2 is under the Apache 2.0 license. For embedding models in particular, I don't think it makes sense to use a closed, proprietary, hosted-only model. Most applications of embedding models involve calculating thousands or even millions of embedding vectors and storing them for later comparison. If your model is proprietary, the vendor is likely someday going to decide to stop offering that model. They'll have a better model to replace it, but you still need to pay to re-calculate those millions of stored existing vectors. (In April 2024 OpenAI offered to "cover the financial cost of users re-embedding content with these new models" - https://openai.com/index/gpt-4-api-general-availability/ - but I don't think that's something we can rely on from every provider.) Notably, I don't want to host the model myself . I'd much rather pay a provider for a hosted model while knowing that if they ever stop hosting it I can run the open weights version myself - or find another vendor who can do that for me. Tags: google , ai , generative-ai , embeddings , gemma

items_all_raw.title: Introducing Mistral Large 4: Le chonk
items_all_raw.summary: Introducing Mistral Large 4: Le chonk Mistral are back in the game. Today they're releasing a preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1 trillion parameter, 49 billion active parameter model trained on their own cluster of 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs. The preview is available via their API. They promise to release the open weights model at the "end of this month". The model only supports two reasoning levels - "none" and "high" - via the Mistral API. Here are both pelicans - the "high" one looks better, though surprisingly it only used 2,717 output tokens compared to "none" which used 3,275: On Artificial Analysis it scores 38 , just behind DeepSeek 4.1 Flash, which is a 552B model. It's a huge improvement on last December's Mistral Large 3, which drew this terrible pelican and scored 9 on AA . It's certainly not a Fable-class model, but it's great to see Mistral put out a model that's back to being maybe about 6 months behind the frontier. Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , mistral , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , llm-release

items_all_raw.title: Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size
items_all_raw.summary: Google released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open model with 740 million parameters that converts text, images, video, audio, and code into vectors. It runs on-device, needs only about 191 MB of RAM, and outperforms some competing models twice its size, according to Google. Paired with a small open model like Gemma 4, it can run offline RAG apps without sending data to external servers. The article Google claims EmbeddingGemma 2 outperforms rival embedding models twice its size appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據 Google 指出，Google 推出了 EmbeddingGemma 2，這是一個擁有 7.4 億個參數的開放模型，能將文字、圖片、影片、音訊和程式碼轉換為向量。它可在裝置上執行，僅需約 191 MB 的記憶體，且效能超越某些體積大上一倍的競爭模型。搭配像 Gemma 4 這樣的小型開放模型，它可以在不需要將資料傳送至外部伺服器的情況下執行離線 RAG 應用程式。文章〈Google 宣稱 EmbeddingGemma 2 的效能超越體積大上一倍的競爭向量模型〉（The Decoder）率先報導。

items_all_raw.summary: According to the Wikimedia Foundation, rogue OpenAI agents edited wikis without permission, tried to abuse a citation tool as a proxy, and may have caused a partial Wikidata Query Service outage through massive crawling. Wikimedia says AI companies need to take responsibility for their agents instead of pushing the burden onto volunteer editors. The article Wikimedia confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents edited wikis, tried to compromise tools, and hammered its infrastructure appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據維基媒體基金會（Wikimedia Foundation）指出，失控的 OpenAI 代理未經許可編輯了維基百科、試圖濫用引用工具作為代理伺服器，並可能透過大規模爬蟲導致 Wikidata 查詢服務部分中斷。維基媒體表示，AI 公司必須為其代理負起責任，而不是將負擔推給志願編輯者。這篇題為「Wikimedia confirms OpenAI's rogue AI agents edited wikis, tried to compromise tools, and hammered its infrastructure」的文章首先發布於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade
items_all_raw.summary: Microsoft published a bearish AI outlook from Nobel economist Daron Acemoglu. He predicts about 1.5 percent GDP growth over ten years and at most five percent of jobs replaced. Bigger models won't move the needle, he argues. What's missing are practical apps that change how work gets done. The article Microsoft publishes Nobel economist's bearish AI forecast of just 1.5% GDP growth over a decade appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 微軟 發表了諾貝爾經濟學獎得主達倫・艾塞默魯（Daron Acemoglu）對人工智慧抱持的悲觀看法。他預測，未來十年的 GDP 成長率大約為 1.5%，且最多隻有百分之五的工作被取代。他認為，更大的模型無法帶來實質改變。真正缺乏的是能夠改變工作方式的實用應用程式。這篇題為 微軟 的文章最先發表在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model
items_all_raw.summary: Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, as a public preview. It is a 1.05 trillion parameter Mixture of Experts model with 49 billion active parameters, native image input, and a 1 million token context window, trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own European datacenters. The API is live now; open weights ship end of October 2026. The post Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Mistral AI 已發布綽號為 Le Chonk 的 Mistral Large 4 進行公開預覽。這是一個擁有 1.05 兆引數的混合專家（MoE）模型，具備 490 億個活躍引數、原生影象輸入以及 100 萬個 Token 的上下文視窗，並在 Mistral's 位於歐洲的資料中心使用 3,800 個 輝達 Grace Blackwell GPU 進行訓練。API 現已上線；開源權重將於 2026 年 10 月底發布。這篇題為「Mistral AI Releases Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): A 1.05T Parameter Multimodal MoE Model」的文章首先發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Scrimshaw Jukebox
items_all_raw.summary: Tool: Scrimshaw Jukebox I wanted to see if Claude Opus 5.5 could compose music, so I tried this : I want you to write some computer game music for me. First design simple text based format for the music and build an artifact that can play it out loud - include some example tracks in that artifact I am looking for music of the quality of the original secret of Monkey Island It leaned a lot harder into the Monkey Island theme than I had intended, but the results are surprisingly good. I wonder if the ability to compose competent music is similar to the 3D graphics thing - a new capability for text models that emerged in the past few months? Would need some careful experiments with other recent and not-so-recent models to confirm if this is new or if they've been able to do this for a while. Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , claude , vibe-coding

items_all_raw.title: Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China
items_all_raw.summary: Reflection has released Beam, its first open-weight model. The mixture-of-experts system activates just 23 billion of its 501 billion parameters per token and aims to match GLM 5.2 on coding and reasoning while using three to four times less compute. The strategy against Chinese open-weight rivals like Deepseek and Qwen is efficiency over raw performance. The article Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Reflection 發布了其首款開放權重模型 Beam。這套混合專家系統在每個 token 中僅啟動 501 億個參數中的 23 億個，旨在以少三到四倍的運算量，在編碼和推理能力上媲美 GLM 5.2。其針對 Deepseek 和 Qwen 等中國開放權重競爭對手的策略是效率優先於原始效能。本文「Reflection's Beam becomes the most capable open-weight model built outside China」最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: ChatGPT圖片生成功能將出現視覺廣告
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI宣佈將擴大ChatGPT廣告測試，10月稍晚將在美國的圖片生成功能中測試新的視覺廣告，以圖片呈現商品或服務，並與使用者生成的圖片分開顯示。OpenAI也擴充廣告成效追蹤及投放安全機制，讓廣告主瞭解廣告是否帶來購買等後續行動，同時避免廣告出現在敏感或不適合的對話旁。 新的視覺廣告會在使用者生成圖片時出現，可使用商品照片、使用情境或服務相關圖片呈現，並會明確標示為廣告，不會混入使用者要求ChatGPT生成的圖片。首波測試僅限美國及部分廣告主，OpenAI表示，廣告也不會影響ChatGPT產生的回答。

items_all_raw.title: Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One
items_all_raw.summary: Reka has released Rho-1, a 19B omni-reasoning model trained from scratch. One network reads and generates text, images, video and robot actions over a shared KV cache. A distilled variant returns a 5.3-second clip in about a second. It is a research preview with no public weights yet. The post Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Reka 推出了 Rho-1，這是一個從頭開始訓練的 190 億參數全能推理模型。單一網路透過共用的 KV 快取來讀取和生成文字、圖像、影片及機器人動作。其蒸餾版本能在約一秒內回傳 5.3 秒的剪輯。這是一個研究預覽版，目前尚未公開模型權重。這篇文章 Reka Releases Rho-1: A 19B Omni-Reasoning Model That Understands, Generates Video and Outputs Robot Actions in One 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields
items_all_raw.summary: JEPA-Anything splits a JEPA's single latent target into 4 orthogonal factors, each with its own predictor. Tested across 7 domains, it beat matched JEPA baselines on all 10 dynamics tasks and cut Interventional Pong intervention error by 34.8%. The post Beyond Domain-Specific World Models: JEPA-Anything Uses 1 Recipe for 7 Fields appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: JEPA-Anything 將 JEPA 的單一潛在目標拆分為 4 個正交因素，每個因素都有自己的預測器。經過 7 個領域的測試，它在所有 10 個動態任務上都擊敗了匹配的 JEPA 基線，並將介入式乓球（Interventional Pong）的介入誤差降低了 34.8%。這篇題為「超越特定領域的世界模型：JEPA-Anything 以 1 種方法適用 7 個領域」的文章最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: 紐約市議會審AI監管草案，四大業者宣誓作證回應模型安全要求
items_all_raw.summary: 紐約市議會10月5日舉行AI安全風險聽證會，OpenAI、Anthropic、Google與Meta代表透過視訊宣誓作證。市議會同時審議多項AI監管草案，其中一項要求在紐約市行銷、販售或部署的AI模型接受獨立第三方驗證，並具備可由人類操作人員關閉模型的技術能力。
